mapper.insert: insert into category (name, type, sort, status, create_user, update_user, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select * from category
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and type = #{type}
order by sort asc, create_time desc
